title: Overlay canvas layout response (PRF-02, catalogue module #14, Vertical Stream Layout)
description: The overlay/browser-source-facing read. One field: layout. No channel id, no timestamp and no entitlement flag -- those are creator-facing only. canvasLayout is null ONLY for an invalid overlay session (revoked/expired/wrong fingerprint/foreign token); a valid session always carries a layout, even for a sub-Pro channel that configured vertical (app_private.list_overlay_canvas_layout, migration 0147, evaluates the 30.3 Pro+ gate INSIDE the read and answers horizontal in that case -- never an error, never null for that reason).
